sentences.en: Every child needs someone to look up to and copy.
sentences.zh: 每个孩子都需要一个榜样来效仿。

sentences.en: Please pack the disks and hard copies into the briefcase.
sentences.zh: 请把磁盘和复印件都装进公文包里。

sentences.en: I am sending a copy of my letter to you.
sentences.zh: 我给你寄了一份信的副本。

senses.zh: 抄件，副本，模仿，一册，稿件
